title: Totem SDK Package Manifest
description: Machine-readable index of all @totemsdk packages — for AI agents, tooling, and developers. Updated 2026-08-18.

cryptographic-foundation.description: WOTS+ signatures, TreeKey hierarchy, MMR proofs, KISSVM, MAST, TxPoW

sovereignty-stack.description: Personal infrastructure — lookup nodes, chain queries, P2P data, real-time streaming

payment-network.description: Eltoo payment channels, routing, factories, statechains, virtual UTXOs, splicing

edge-computing.description: IoT/industrial runtime — transport connectors, MQTT, P2P, gateways, runtime harnesses

verifiable-claims.description: WOTS-signed proofs, DID identities, manifests, AI agent policies, on-chain governance, reputation

intelligence.description: Provider-neutral intelligence contracts and the QVAC in-situ inference adapter — capabilities, operations, usage receipts for local self-hosted AI

storage.description: Provider-neutral storage contracts and adapters — StorageError taxonomy, versioned codec, namespaces, transactions + CAS, and the pluggable ArtifactStoreBackend artifact port
